subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should Control UI stopping a selected non-global channel session intentionally discard that session’s queued followup and lane work via `clearQueued: true`?
rationale: The implementation can preserve legacy callers, but choosing whether a user stop should cancel queued successor work is a durable Gateway/API and user-workflow contract rather than a mechanical defect fix.

options.title: Approve selected-session queue clearing
options.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` only for the Control UI’s selected non-global session stop path, retaining existing behavior for all callers that omit it.

options.title: Stop active work only
options.body: Keep the selected-session abort but remove queue deletion so queued followups retain the existing promotion behavior.

options.title: Pause for a narrower contract
options.body: Defer merge until the gateway/session owners define whether queue clearing belongs in a public `sessions.abort` option or a Control UI-specific operation.

recommendation.title: Approve selected-session queue clearing
recommendation.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` only for the Control UI’s selected non-global session stop path, retaining existing behavior for all callers that omit it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the current Gateway and session-lifecycle history owners, which could not be resolved without repository history access.
